programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dockter Visit
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Capitol Crimes
programme.desc: The driver said he couldn't have hit and killed a pedestrian on a Harrisburg street. The Jeep Grand Cherokee he was leasing around that time had been sold months ago to a buyer in another state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Everybody Lies
programme.desc: After church, deacon Robert Walton is beaten to death in a public park. The case heats up when Lt. Kenda and his team revisit an old friend with a secret. Did the religious leader have a dark side?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Grip
programme.desc: When a speeding truck crashes into a residential building, officers find the lifeless body of Michael Faast behind the wheel. But he didn’t die in the wreck – he was shot point-blank in the temple.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead On Target
programme.desc: A young father-to-be is shot dead in broad daylight by a single bullet fired from afar. At the crime scene, Kenda recognizes the hallmark of a skilled sniper.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Chance Encounter
programme.desc: When firefighters find Victor Woods stabbed to death in his burning apartment, homicide detective Joe Kenda tracks Colorado's most notorious serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Worst Fear
programme.desc: Police are shocked to find a 13-year-old boy killed in an explosion, but their grief turns to alarm when they discover a second, unexploded bomb.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Outlaw
programme.desc: When a gunfight erupts at a local biker bar and claims the lives of two men, Lt. Joe Kenda must delve deep into the world of an infamous biker gang.

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: iCarly: Halvenween
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget holder en "Halfoween"-fest, for de synes, at det skal være Halloween to gange om året. Men da en forklædt gæst snører Carly og vennerne, bliver festen lidt for vild.

programme.title: iCarly: I Kamp med Chip
programme.desc: Et vredt barn ønsker inderligt at hævne sig, men Spencer prøver ihærdigt at stoppe ham. Gibby bliver knust, når hans nye legetøjslaserpistol går i stykker, men bliver himmelhenrykt, når Freddies reparation giver den en overraskende kraft.

programme.title: iCarly: Bandlyst
programme.desc: Da Carly bandlyser T-Bo fra loftet, gør han gengæld ved ikke at lukke Carly ind på Groovy Smoothie. Imens opdager Freddie og Gibby, der er mange fordele ved at være med i et band ... og også et par ulemper.

programme.title: iCarly: Hovedløs i Las Vegas
programme.desc: Da Sam opdager, at hendes mor sidder i fængsel i Las Vegas, beslutter slænget sig for at samle deres mest kostbare ejendele, køre til Vegas og pantsætte deres ting for at få penge til kaution. Gæstestjerner: History Channel's PAWN STARS.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly i knibe
programme.desc: Sams ven kommer ud af ungdomsfængslet, og Sam advarer alle om at holde sig væk, men Carly hører ikke efter og kommer ud på dybt vand. I loftet finder Spencer et par briller med natkikkert.

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York. De elsker New York og er vildt glade for at være med i programmet, men alt kan ske i live tv.

programme.title: iCarly: Bukseskandalen (del 2)
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-slænget til at optræde live på sit program i New York, men en stor garderobefejl fra Gibby betyder store problemer for netshowets fremtid.

programme.title: iCarly: Spencers nye venner
programme.desc: iCarly-slænget vil finde venner til Spencer på hans egen alder. De finder nogle gode muligheder, men vil venskaber blomstre?

programme.title: iCarly: Stop tyven!
programme.desc: Da Sams bærbare bliver stjålet, prøver iCarly-slænget at hjælpe hende med at opspore tyven. Imens må Spencer ikke besøge sin yndlingsspillehal, hvis han ikke er i følgeskab med et barn. Hans held vender, når Guppy har brug for en babysitter.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly takker af (del 2)
programme.desc: Carly er parat til at acceptere, at hun ikke skal med til den årlige fest, da hendes far dukker op. Hendes aften tager en uventet drejning, da hendes far stiller hende et livsforandrende spørgsmål.

programme.title: iCarly: En megafed idé
programme.desc: Da frøken Briggs nægter at lade alle Carly og Sams favoritter deltage i talentshowet, beslutter de at være værter for deres dygtige klassekammerater på deres egen onlinewebshow, iCarly.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Boarding Group One
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der ikke får lov at gå om bord i en flyver, en bølle, der nægter at hælde en flaske sprut ud og en bokser, der sviner sin modstander til.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Country Music
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Steve Jobs' efterfølger, Ice-T som en uartig hvalp og Rihanna og Chris Brown prøver igen.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en narkohandel, der går galt, en mafiafyr, der er en stor tudemarie, og Darius Rucker, der prøver at håndterer sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister bliver sparket i skridtet på grund af deres kunst, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mand prøver at få heldet med sig til et møde for sexmisbrugere.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Non-Stop Party
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en fyr, der jagter sin kæreste til Jordens ende og LMFAO, der ikke kan holde op med at feste.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Y'all Ready For This?
programme.desc: Et football-hold hyper sig før en kamp, president Obama og Luther møder Hillary Clinton, to fyre forbereder sig på potentielle trusler på et fly, pirater synger en sang og en betjent er lidt for skydeglad.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Scariest Movie Ever
programme.desc: A vampyr afslører sig selv, en seriemorder bliver bremset og et barn får sit ønske opfyldt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sexy Vampires
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en uhyggelig asiatisk spøgelsesbofælle, fyrene ser på den lyse side af tortur og Keegan oplever et hus fyldt med sexede vampyrer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dubstep
programme.desc: Præsident Obama og hans vredesoversætter, Luther, taler til Mitt Romney, vi møder manden, der skulle tale efter Martin Luther Kings 'I Have A Dream'-tale, og to venner taler om, hvad der sker med deres bæ, efter de skyller ud.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana leder febrilsk efter en gave i sidste øjeblik til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver at finde et klimaanlæg for at få det køligt i soveværelset.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Der dukker nye muligheder op, når Abbi endelig kan træne nogen på Soulstice og Ilana får succes som firmachef.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi skal have sine visdomstænder trukket ud og Ilana ser det som sin pligt at passe hende til hun får det bedre - hvilket selvfølgelig indebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og et totalt mangel på tilsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Pigerne leder efter den perfekte fest, hvilket afslører en underlig og surrealistisk side af Abbi, som bekræfter Ilanas værste anelser.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Slænget skal fejre, at Jaime er blevet amerikansk statsborger, men Bevers leder Abbi og Ilana på afveje ved at love dem gratis sprut. Imens må Lincoln og Jaime klare sig selv blandt alle advokaterne.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi prøver at finde en forsvunden frakke, mens Ilana udforsker en ny romance - som føles besynderligt velbekendt.

programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana får et tøjproblem på vej til en venindes udstilling og samtidig har de desperat brug for et offentligt toilet.

programme.desc: Abbi må lade, som om hun er Ilana for at tage hendes vagt på jobbet, mens Ilana tager til Long Island på grund af en meget vigtig lægeaftale.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Monster Energy
programme.desc: En gudfrygtig kvinde fører en kampagne mod energidrikke og Daniel afslører, hvordan seerne kan blive rige ved at bruge deres computere.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Shoenice
programme.desc: En vagabond får en kendisprofil, et kritikerkryb får ris og Daniel gør en indsats for at bekæmpe racisme i USA.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Jackie B.
programme.desc: Daniel laver et remix sammen med en rapgudinde, renser internettet bit for bit og skaber en ny hashtag for at styrke kvinder.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Sting Wrestling Fan
programme.desc: Daniel tager brydergreb på en wrestlingfan, bliver grillet af millioner af sine nærmeste venner og gør gaden sikker for moderigtige folk alle vegne.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Atheist In A Foxhole
programme.desc: Daniel profilerer en hedning i halterneck, fortæller om sit eksklusive møde med en politiker fra Alaska og skriver en sang til studenterfyre, der ikke er racistisk, chauvinistisk eller stødende.

programme.title: Tosh.0: RC Car
programme.desc: En radiostyret bils netoprettelse bliver lidt 'Fast' og lidt 'Furious', 'Tosh.0'-personalet spiser menneskemad og Daniel bliver scientolog, kendissernes officielle religion.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Sign Spinner
programme.desc: Daniel taler med en tamburmajor, der får mindsteløn, hylder de modige mænd og kvinder som bærer falske uniformer og skænker lidt veltrængt fugtighed til Californien.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Girl Dunks
programme.desc: Daniel giver en Juwanna Mann-wannebee netoprettelse, forvandler nedladende homofobiske skældsord til kvalitetsprodukter og møder en meget usædvanlig baby.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Microwave Glow Stick
programme.desc: Daniel giver en knægt, der ikke er mikroovnssikker netoprettelse, søger at efterligne talkshows med dumme quizzer i stedet for at være sjov og gør det sjovt at sørge over ens elskede.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Fedora Hero Saves Eggs
programme.desc: Daniel løfter på hatten for en ydmygt pralende helt, taler med sig selv som teenager og hjælper to usædvanlige mennesker med at finde hinanden.

programme.title: Tosh.0: High School Football Fan
programme.desc: Daniel profilerer en unik high school-footballfan, beviser, at han er bedre end alle andre og viser, at bladblæsere kan være farlige, hvis de ikke anvendes korrekt.

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ditzel er rejst helt hen til det lokale indkøbscenter, for der plejer Julemanden jo altid at hænge ud med en masse unger på skødet. Det er et oplagt sted at starte!

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ingen held i indkøbscenteret, men nu har Ditzel totalt regnet den ud! For han er faldet over beviser på, at Julemanden skulle bo på et sted kaldet Granland med masser af grønne grantræer.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ditzel er desperat! Han har brugt tre dage i sin søgen efter Julemanden, men uden held. Og desperate situationer kræver jo som bekendt desperate handlinger, så derfor rejser Ditzel simpelthen tilbage i tiden til 1800-tallet.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Det er 25. december, og julen er overstået - men det ved Ditzel ikke, og stor er glæden da også, da han støder ind i selveste nissen Pyrus fra den der julekalender med 3D-brillerne!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: For at få afdækket en smule af pubertetens mysterie, og måske ændret ved Jacobs vrangforestillinger deraf, er de taget et smut forbi en ekspert på området.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er blevet kropsbevidst. Selvom han i forvejen er en ‘hunk', er der et par skridt endnu, før han når ‘stunner’, og dét har han tænkt sig at gøre noget ved. Derfor er han taget i fitnesscenter for at få styr på sin bod’.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Det er endelig lykkes Lars at overbevise Jacob om, at selvom puberteten er skrøbelig og forvirrende størrelse, er alt ved den også helt og aldeles normalt. Ja, også at onanere. Sidstnævnte viser sig at det er en sand pandoras æske.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er ved at forberede sig til klassefesten. Jacob og Lars er ikke helt enige i, hvordan man gebærder sig overfor det modsatte køn. Derfor tager de ud til en, der underviser i takt og tone.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Lars har fået ondt af Jacob. Han husker selv hvor svært den slags med tøser kunne være, og kan være. Derfor har Lars (måske mod betaling) fået fat i en “tøs”, der trods den ret voldsomme aldersforskel, er interesseret i en date med Jacob.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob har nået konfirmationsalderen, men han er dog ikke videre begejstret over konfirmationsforberedelserne og den svage præst. Og biblen? Bare topnoller fiktion fra øverste hylde.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob er blevet Kristian ad helvedes til, for jo mere man tror på Jesus, jo flere gaver får man til sin kongdiamation! Jacob er derfor taget til epicentret af al skam, lyst og synd - Bycentret - hvor han prøver at frelse alle de rådne sjæle.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob skal selvfølgelig have nyt tøj prøver samtidigt at holde hjulene i samfundet kørende ved at bruge rigtig maaaange pang'. Kviklån? Ja tak. Let's go shopping!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 2

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 3

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 5

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 6

programme.title: Becker

programme.title: Becker
programme.desc: An unflattering picture of someone other than John is placed in an article about him, causing him distress.

programme.title: Becker

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Danger
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Safe Place
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Live Wire
programme.desc: A bomb, constructed to cause as much damage as possible, kills a victim with deadly force and flame. When a painstaking search yields some tiny clues, police are able to identify the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Van-ished
programme.desc: A twelve-year-old girl claimed she had been abducted and sexually assaulted. She recounted what happened in such a flat, unemotional voice that police found it difficult to believe her. Fibers on her clothing would prove she was telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Novel Idea
programme.desc: When the number and volume of bloodstains at the scene was greater than usual, it was up to forensic scientists to find out why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Outlaw
programme.desc: When a gunfight erupts at a local biker bar and claims the lives of two men, Lt. Joe Kenda must delve deep into the world of an infamous biker gang.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Time Bomb
programme.desc: In 1978, Lt. Joe Kenda is new to the CSPD, and gets more than he bargains for when a local bank is the target of a massive explosion.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Timothy Peart’s Last Dance
programme.desc: When a teen is killed at a party, police question the guests and wonder if they’re all part of a cover-up.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Knock Knock
programme.desc: A gathering of friends turns deadly when two gunmen shoot William Davis in the head. Kenda and his team dig into his past and start to suspect someone in William’s circle is lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: New Year's Evil
programme.desc: It’s New Year’s Eve weekend, and in the midst of the revelry Miguel Mendez is beaten to death outside a convenience store. Lt. Joe Kenda faces a challenging investigation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments

programme.title: iCarly: En megafed idé
programme.desc: Da frøken Briggs nægter at lade alle Carly og Sams favoritter deltage i talentshowet, beslutter de at være værter for deres dygtige klassekammerater på deres egen onlinewebshow, iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Hr. Næsten Perfekt
programme.desc: Carly er lun på Jake, som går på skolen. Han er supercool og ser godt ud. Carly er vild med Jake, så hun inviterer ham til at spille guitar og synge i hendes nye webshow. Hun finder desværre ud af, at Jake er en forfærdelig sanger.

programme.title: iCarly: Kampagne-konkurrencen
programme.desc: Carly og Sam konkurrerer mod Freddie og Spencer om hvem, der kan få flest børn til at se iCarly webcast. Men det stikker helt af, da alle deres planer går grueligt galt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anmelders gunst
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie vil gerne have deres webshow anmeldt af 'Nevelocity', et superpopulært websted, der anmeldelser hjemmesider og webcasts. Da Carly skal møde Nevel finder hun ud af, at han er en irriterende dreng, der gerne vil på date med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Ude godt, men Spencer er bedst
programme.desc: Carly og Spencers bedstefar kommer på uanmeldt besøg. Han er meget bekymret for, om Spencer er for uansvarlig og skør til at være Carlys værge. Det er op til Carly og hendes venner at overbevise hendes bedstefar om, at Spencer er en ansvarlig værge.

programme.title: iCarly: Rekordforsøget
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at slå verdensrekorden i den længste, sammenhængende webcast. For at slå rekorden skal iCarly være på i mere end 24 timer i træk.

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: En iCarly-fan, Valerie, inviterer Freddie på en date. Daten går så godt, at Freddie begynder at filme Valeries eget webshow. Men Freddie føler sig splittet, da Valeries webshow skaber problemer for iCarly-webshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunstneriske kvaler
programme.desc: Carly inviterer Spencers kunsthelt, Harry Joyner, til at kigge på Spencers kunstværker. Da Harry kalder Spencers kunst for amatøragtigt, føler Spencer, at hans liv ikke længere giver mening.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarlys største fan
programme.desc: iCarlys største fan, Mandy, inviteres til at se en livesending af iCarly. Men Mandy viser sig at være mere stalker end fan, så de må gøre alt for at slippe af med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Rugemor
programme.desc: Carly og Sam forsøger at udklække kyllinger i et naturvidenskabsprojekt. Men æggene klækker tidligere end forventet, og pludselig er der kyllinger overalt i lejligheden! Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer må finde kyllingerne i lejligheden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg gider ikke slås
programme.desc: Carly laver en en unik iCarly T-shirt til Sam for at markere årsdagen for deres venskab. Men da Sam bytter den for koncertbilletter, bliver de to venner uvenner.
